{{Quote|Welcome to Tosche Station. If you are looking to get the most out of your speeder I have what you need.|[[Cuan Talon]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tosche Station|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Tosche Station''' was a power and distribution station located outside the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the power source of a number of surrounding cities, via dozens of sturdy underground cables. It stocked useful supplies for the local [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] such as [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]]. The station also provided services such as vehicle repairs and equipment recharging.

==History==
{{Quote|But I was going into Tosche Station to pick up some power converters!"<br />"You can waste time with your friends when your chores are done.|Luke Skywalker and [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]|audio=ToscheStation.flac|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tosche_station_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Inside Tosche Station in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].]]
The station, originally constructed in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]],<ref name="SoT" /> was named after its owner [[Merl Tosche/Legends|Merl Tosche]], who rarely visited. Tosche's frequent absence meant that the station was usually managed by [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze "Fixer" Loneozner]]. As a result, it became a popular gathering place for local youths such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]].

Fixer spent most of his time at Tosche Station working on building an illegal [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] from spare parts, which he then planned to sell in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to earn [[Currency/Legends|money]] for his wedding with his girlfriend [[Camie Loneozner|Camie]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Luke came to Tosche Station to tell Biggs that he saw a [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] taking place above Tatooine, and was subsequently ridiculed.<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tosche Station was run by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Cuan Talon]].<ref name="SWG:TS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Station warehouse manager [[Janus]] was killed by [[Desert Demons]] after his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] broke down in the desert. In the meantime, spacers hired by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] as well as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] approached Cuan as they were both looking for a droid recently acquired by Janus from [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="SWG:TS" /> At the same time, wild creatures dug up and damaged the underground power cables, causing a blackout in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. Fixer was forced to hire hunters to destroy the creatures in the area to make way for repairs.<ref name="SWG:AD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Anchorhead Defender}} on Tatooine</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ToscheStation-Insider35.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The original filming location. Diagram reflects old "Toshi" spelling.]]
Tosche Station was supposed to appear in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but was cut from the film. The scene was, however, released in the deleted scenes of the special features of the Blu-Ray release of the original trilogy. The scene shows [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] telling his friends, including [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Fixer]], about a space battle he saw above the planet.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>

The filming location is locally known as [[Sidi Jemour]], on the Island of [[Djerba]], [[Tunisia]].

In older sources such as the comic [[Star Wars (1977) 31|''Star Wars'' (1977) 31]] and [[Star Wars Insider 35|''Star Wars Insider'' 35]] and the original script to Episode IV ''A New Hope'', it is spelled "Toshi Station."<ref name="Star Wars 1977 31">[[Star Wars (1977) 31|''Star Wars'' (1977) 31]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars Insider 35">[[Star Wars Insider 35|''Star Wars Insider'' 35]]</ref>

The station also appears in the training mission in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'' and the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>
